intro: We do not publish package prices, because a roof price that is real depends on things nobody can see from a website — the size and pitch of your roof, how many layers are already on it, the condition of the decking underneath, the number of valleys, chimneys and skylights that have to be flashed properly, and which material you actually want. Anyone quoting a firm number before getting on the roof is guessing, and the difference between the guess and the invoice is the part that ruins the job. What we will tell you is this: the estimate is free, it comes to you in writing rather than shouted from the driveway, and the payment schedule is written into it before anything is signed. If you want a ballpark to plan around, call (570) 614-3914 and ask — we will give you a range and be honest about what would move it.
notes: Free estimates across Lackawanna and Luzerne counties. Deposit and payment terms are set out in writing on every estimate — ask before you sign, always, with any contractor.
